exposure: Propineb (400 ppm in 5 ml distilled water) administered to pregnant female rats for 16 days of gestation
outcome: Cell infiltration in the dental papilla
Degeneration in the mesenchymal cells of the outer enamel
Morphological changes in tooth bud, enamel, and dentin
Expression of VEGF (Endothelial cell growth factor)
cohort: Infant rats obtained by cesarean section whose mothers received 400 ppm propineb during 16 days of gestation.
finding: Propineb exposure during gestation led to odontoblast cell hyperplasia, cell infiltration in the dental papilla, degeneration in outer enamel mesenchymal cells, and morphological changes suggesting delayed tooth formation in infant rats.
